verdict.rationale: Microsoft support docs cover feature-specific help (PC Health Check, BitLocker key backup, desktop features like Snap layouts, Windows Hello) which could help a new user learn parts of the desktop, but there is no evidence of a dedicated 'switcher' onboarding tutorial or step-by-step OS installation guide; community threads even note setup friction (forced Microsoft account, PIN-only login) rather than smooth guided onboarding. missing for 10: a first-party switcher/install walkthrough, a structured 'learn the desktop' tutorial series, and independent confirmation such tutorials work well for new users.
